paragraphs.source_en: An upright man had risen to eminence overnight; his desires had swelled without end until the boundary between fantasy and reality grew blurred. Ieyasu understood—he had promoted the man too quickly. It seemed, then, that those who rose too swiftly might indeed conceive ambitions beyond their station. Realizing this, Ieyasu was forced to reconsider the disposition of forces for the coming campaign.
